faqs.q: What is the Oteco plunger-type drill pipe float valve (Models F, FC, FA)?
faqs.a: The Oteco plunger-type float valve sits in a float sub or bit sub above the bit and stops drilling fluid, cuttings and well fluid flowing back up the drill string. This listing covers Models F, FC and FA in sizes 1R to 6F, standard and sour gas (H2S), in 43 assemblies. See [oilfield float valves](/c/oilfield-float-valves).

faqs.q: What do Oteco float valve Models F, FC and FA mean?
faqs.a: Model F is the standard plunger. Model FC is automatic fill: a key holds the plunger open while running in so the string fills, until flow releases it (2F-3R to 6F). Model FA is pressure monitoring: a port through the plunger lets you read shut-in pressure below the valve (all sizes). Part numbers such as IH-OTC-480131200 name the model and size.

faqs.q: Which Oteco plunger float valve size do I need: 1R, 2F-3R, 3.5IF, 4F, 5F-6R or 6F?
faqs.a: Match the size to your float sub or bit sub. Oteco's bit-sub table pairs 1R with a 2-3/8" thread, 1F-2R with 2-7/8", 2F-3R with 3-1/2", 4R with 4-1/2" and 5R with 5-1/2" (API Regular). The plunger Model F is listed in 1R, 2F-3R, 3.5IF, 4F, 5F-6R and others to 6F; ask us if your size is not on the list.

faqs.q: What is the recess size for an Oteco plunger float valve in a sub?
faqs.a: The valve recess in the sub is A = valve length L + the tool-joint pin length + 1/4-inch clearance, and T can be ignored if it is the same as or smaller than the tool-joint ID. For example size 2F-3R has valve diameter D 2-13/32, recess diameter R 2-7/16 and length L 6-1/2 inches.

faqs.q: What temperature range does the Oteco plunger float valve have?
faqs.a: Oteco gives 0 °F to 450 °F, depending on the seal. Seals are nitrile, HNBR or Viton, and springs are Inconel as standard. Pick the seal for the well fluid and temperature, and tell us the conditions so we confirm the right assembly.

faqs.q: What is the Oteco plunger float valve made of, and is there a sour gas (H2S) version?
faqs.a: Oteco float valves have one-piece cast bodies, not welded, in ductile iron or low-alloy steel heat treated to 22 HRC or below for sour-gas hardness. Plungers are machined from one solid piece. Standard and sour gas (H2S) versions are both listed, for example Model F in 1R as standard IH-OTC-480131200 and sour gas IH-OTC-480301200, with Model FA also offered in sour gas.

faqs.q: What approvals does Oteco state for the plunger float valve?
faqs.a: Oteco's literature for the plunger float valves gives materials, sizes and fit, and makes no third-party approval claim. Oteco Inc. holds ISO 9001 certification as a company. Ask us for the maker's documentation when you order, and tell us if your project needs specific paperwork so we can check what is available.

faqs.q: Which baffle plates, repair kits and pullers go with the Oteco plunger float valve?
faqs.a: See [Oteco baffle plates](/p/oteco-float-valve-baffle-plates), [metal and rubber repair kits](/p/oteco-float-valve-repair-kits) and [spare parts and pullers](/p/oteco-float-valve-spare-parts-pullers). The F, FC and FA use rubber kit F (eight side seals and two valve seals) and metal kit F (plunger valve, seal disc, valve guide and three springs).

faqs.q: How often can an Oteco plunger float valve be redressed?
faqs.a: Metal repair kits dress a valve three times and rubber kits four times. Pullers remove the valve from the sub. Oteco makes its float valves and parts to standard industry dimensions so they fit standard float subs and bit subs. Parts: [repair kits](/p/oteco-float-valve-repair-kits).

faqs.q: Plunger or flapper: how do Oteco Model F and Model G float valves compare?
faqs.a: Both stop backflow in the drill string. The plunger (F, FC, FA) is machined from one solid piece and spans 1R to 6F, while the flapper (G, GA, GC, GCA) uses a case-hardened low-alloy flapper and spans 1F-2R to 5F-6R, with a smaller valve ID in each size. See [Oteco flapper float valves](/p/oteco-drill-pipe-float-valve-flapper).

faqs.q: What is the Oteco flapper-type drill pipe float valve (Models G, GA, GC, GCA)?
faqs.a: The Oteco flapper-type float valve sits in a float sub or bit sub above the bit and stops drilling fluid, cuttings and well fluid flowing back up the drill string. This listing covers Models G, GA, GC and GCA in sizes 1F-2R to 5F-6R, standard and sour gas (H2S), in 53 assemblies. See [oilfield float valves](/c/oilfield-float-valves).

faqs.q: What do Oteco float valve Models G, GA, GC and GCA mean?
faqs.a: Model G is the standard flapper. Model GA is pressure monitoring: a tungsten-carbide insert with a 1/4-inch orifice in the flapper. Model GC is automatic fill with a self-releasing key, and GCA is automatic fill and pressure monitoring. G and GA run 1F-2R to 5F-6R, GC and GCA 2F-3R to 5F-6R. Part numbers like IH-OTC-480151422 name the model and size.

faqs.q: Which Oteco flapper float valve size do I need: 1F-2R, 2F-3R, 3F, 3.5IF, 4R, 4F, 5R or 5F-6R?

faqs.q: How do the Oteco Model G valve ID and length vary by size?
faqs.a: Oteco's brochure gives the Model G valve ID as 1 inch at 1F-2R, 1-1/4 at 2F-3R, 1-5/8 at 3F and 3.5IF, 1-31/32 at 4R, 2-3/16 at 4F, 2-1/4 at 5R and 2-7/8 at 5F-6R. Valve lengths run from 6-1/4 inches at 1F-2R to 11-3/4 inches at 5F-6R.
